title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions from this week's verified Israel Sports Pulse coverage — taekwondo history, a European away night, and Rodri's rare treble.

questions.question: In her bronze-medal match at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, which fighter did Avishag Semberg beat 27-22 to win Israel's first-ever taekwondo medal?
questions.explanation: Semberg beat Turkey's Rukiye Yıldırım 27-22 in the bronze medal match, giving Israel its first medal of the Tokyo Games and its first Olympic taekwondo medal.

questions.question: Hapoel Tel Aviv advanced 3-2 on aggregate past GKS Katowice to reach the Conference League play-off round. Who do they face next, and where is the first leg played?
answers: Atlético Madrid, first leg in Madrid
questions.explanation: Hapoel Tel Aviv advanced to face Atalanta in the play-off round, with the first leg on August 20 in Bergamo and the return leg in Miskolc, Hungary.

questions.question: Rodri became the 11th player in football history to win the World Cup, the Champions League and which other honour?
questions.explanation: Rodri had already won the Champions League with Manchester City (2023) and the Ballon d'Or (2024) before Spain's 2026 World Cup win completed the rare treble.

questions.question: What height did Yonathan Kapitolnik clear to finish tied for fifth in the men's high jump final at the 2026 European Athletics Championships in Birmingham?
questions.explanation: Kapitolnik cleared 2.23m to share fifth place, missing out on bronze after failing all three attempts at 2.27m.

questions.question: Anastasia Gorbenko posted the fastest time in the women's 200m individual medley heats at the 2026 European Aquatics Championships in Paris. What was her time?
questions.explanation: Gorbenko led all qualifiers into the final in 2:11.87, just ahead of Ireland's Ellen Walshe at 2:12.12.
